_comment: Model + prompt configuration for the Free Fact Checker extension. Edit and deploy to change the models offered, the default model, and the fact-check prompt, without shipping a new extension build. Models must support grounding with Google Search. defaultPrompt must contain the [[text]] placeholder or it is rejected and the bundled prompt is used. thinkingConfig is passed straight to the Gemini SDK: an object sets it, null sends none at all, omitting the key infers it from the model id. Gemma accepts thinkingLevel MINIMAL or HIGH only - not LOW/MEDIUM, and no thinkingBudget; MINIMAL is essential, since Gemma's default thinking can run for minutes on a multi-claim check.
defaultPrompt:
I am reading some content online and I need to know whether I can trust it or not. Please evaluate it and tell me if the statement(s) are true or not. Here is the text that I'm reading: ---------------------------------- [[text]] ---------------------------------- Always search the web to check the claim(s) before answering — even if you are confident you already know the answer — and cite the sources you used. You can use Markdown and HTML in your answer. At the very bottom of your response, put one of the following verdicts (copy exactly as shown): If the statement is true:
TRUE
If the statement is false:
FALSE
If the statement is not totally true or false:
MIXED
If you don't know, then don't put anything at the bottom.
